scope: Actual direct/selector overflow callback, structured cache/clock and Nordic init/std1/dequeue/formatter/pool/RTT graph; all modes, deferred/immediate, clock flag, names, masks; terminal loop boundary
limitations: Clock/RTC registration is a controlled fixture binding to actual C snapshot/default-clock providers. Memory-backed RTT writes are not host delivery. Overflow is terminal so ABI return restoration is not claimed. No physical task failure/concurrency or image byte identity proof.
